text:
maya: Heads up — I'm seeing duplicate credit memos in NetSuite for some Stripe chargebacks this morning. A few customers have two credit memos for the same chargeback id.

raj: Is this only chargebacks or other refunds too?

maya: Only chargebacks so far. Pulled a sample: CH_1K9abcXYZ appears twice, netSuite ids CM-2345 and CM-2346.

lucas: I pulled webhook logs, looks like Stripe sent the same `charge.dispute.closed` event twice with different timestamps. Delivery timestamps: 2026-03-23T09:11:02Z and 2026-03-23T09:11:14Z. Payload `id` is the same: evt_1K9abc123.

lucas: snippet from our enqueue service logs:
```
2026-03-23T09:11:02Z enqueue: evt_1K9abc123 -> transform-job idempotency=charge_1K9abcXYZ
2026-03-23T09:11:14Z enqueue: evt_1K9abc123 -> transform-job idempotency=charge_1K9abcXYZ
```

billing-bot: webhook-retry: Stripe delivered retry attempt #2 for evt_1K9abc123 (response 200).

maya: Hmm. Our transform sets NetSuite idempotency to `charge_{charge.id}_{date}`. If the delivery timestamps differ and we include date derived from event.received_at in the key, small timezone rounding or DST handling could produce different date strings. That would bypass dedupe.

raj: Ah — we used `event.received_at` for the date portion. Should use `event.id` or the Stripe `id` alone for dedupe.

lucas: Agree. I have a draft PR to change dedupe key to `stripe_event_id` and fall back to `charge.id` if missing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-transform/pull/312. Patch includes migration to reconcile duplicate credit memos.

lucas: To test locally:
```bash
# run transform with sample webhook
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data @sample_evt.json http://localhost:8080/webhook
# confirm idempotency key assigned:
grep -A2 "idempotency_key" logs/local.log
```

ops: Please don't run the reconciliation script until finance signs off. We should also block automated retries creating new records.

maya: Understood. Raj — can you review the PR and approve a hotfix? We need to prevent more duplicates.

raj: Looking now. Will approve if tests and a backfill plan included. Also request a one-off reconciliation job to find duplicates created after 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC.

lucas: Adding backfill script in PR. It marks duplicates and creates reversal entries instead of immediate deletes.

maya: Thanks. If this is an idempotency key bug, billing team to monitor reconciliation runs and hold any automatic NetSuite pushes for 2 hours while we deploy. :thumbsup:

ops: Noted — putting a short hold on NetSuite push queue for billing for 2 hours (starting 09:45 UTC).

maya: I'll compile affected customer list and send to cs for outreach.

raj: Approved the hotfix with tests. Please notify me when deployed to staging.

lucas: Deploying to staging now. Will post results.

billing-bot: deploy: staging billing-transform v1.14.2 started by lucas

lucas: Staging run processed 20 sample events including duplicates — dedupe now prevents creating the second CM.

maya: Good catch. Follow-up: add unit test for timezone edge and add note to runbook.

ops: Will lift the hold after 2 hours if no regressions.

maya: Thanks all.
